lines.text: The `upload_vita`, `upload_vpk`, and `run` targets send the build to a Vita over FTP. They need the Vita's IP in `PSVITAIP` at configure time (Compose passes it into the container), e.g. `PSVITAIP=192.168.1.177 docker compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake -S . -B out-vita && cmake --build out-vita --target run"`. They fail with a message when it is unset.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: chore: record vendored patches; upload_vita syncs emoji assets (#99)
lines.text: `upload_vpk` copies the VPK to `ux0:/download/` for a manual install. `upload_vita` (and `run`) stops the running app, uploads `eboot.bin`, the runtime and the fonts, then relaunches. It also uploads `assets/emoji` (about 4,000 PNGs in one curl run), but only the first time per build directory and Vita IP and again when the images change, tracked by `out-vita/upload_emoji-<ip>.stamp`; delete that stamp to force a re-upload, e.g. after removing the app from the Vita.

lines.summary: fix(fonts): evict atlas pages between frames; Korean fallback with block-gated lazy loads (#100)
lines.text: - Configure downloads the pinned DejaVu Sans, Droid Sans Fallback Full, Noto Sans KR and Twemoji releases once into the gitignored `assets/fonts/` and `assets/emoji/` (`cmake/fonts.cmake`, `cmake/twemoji.cmake`, SHA-256 checked by `cmake/fetch_asset.cmake`); host and VPK builds both ship them. Offline it warns and builds with fallbacks: raylib's built-in font for the Runtime Default Font, missing-glyph boxes for CJK and Korean, a fallback glyph for emoji. The next configure retries.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: - Host only: `cmake --build out --target stage_examples` copies every built `js/examples/*/dist/*.vdapp` into `out/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps`; `cmake --build out --target run` builds, stages, and launches `out/vitadeck`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: build: rebuild JS for vitadeck and on scaffold edits, refuse in-source builds
lines.text: - Host only: the `js` target (a dependency of `vitadeck`, `stage_examples`, `run`, and the smoke harnesses) runs `pnpm build` when the JS inputs globbed in `CMakeLists.txt` are newer than `js/dist/runtime/runtime.js`. Cleaning a host build removes that file from the source tree, so the next host build reruns pnpm and a Vita build needs `pnpm --dir js build` first. The Vita build never runs pnpm.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: build: one parallel run target, JS as a real dependency
lines.text: - `out/js` and `out/assets` are symlinks into the source tree, created at configure time, so the host reads the current runtime and assets without a copy step.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Consolidate agent build guidance
lines.text: - The **`vitadeck`** CLI is a compiled **`js/packages/sdk/dist/cli.mjs`** (plus **`dist/templates/`**); **`pnpm --dir js install`** runs the workspace **`prepare`** script, which builds **`@vitadeck/sdk`**.
